subject: website
name: Slotray
summary: A browser tool that decodes a verified contract's storage slots. No public repository was found, and the page is a minified Next.js build with no source maps, so there is no public source and it stays at Level 2. It makes no request when it opens; its Etherscan and RPC calls start when a contract is looked up.

connections.name: Etherscan API and RPC endpoints (api.etherscan.io, Alchemy)
connections.note: Used when a contract is looked up, without a light client.
